_comment: Minimal ClawHub-style skill manifest that exposes mnesio as an OpenClaw skill by wrapping its MCP server. Field names follow the common skill/MCP-wrapper shape; adjust to your OpenClaw/ClawHub version's schema. The three tools mirror mnesio-mcp exactly.
name: mnesio-memory
description: Self-improving long-term memory for the agent: write/search memories and record task outcomes that feed a safety-gated procedural compiler. Versioned, bi-temporal, crypto-shred erasable.

tools.name: mnesio_write_memory
tools.summary: Append a memory (embedding + evolution happen async, off the write path).

tools.name: mnesio_search
tools.summary: Hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 + RRF); returns memories + citations.

tools.name: mnesio_record_outcome
tools.summary: Record a task outcome; the gated procedural compiler learns from it.
